text: 你沿踪迹走了将近一英里，终于听见低声交谈。你爬到一大片熊果灌木旁，拨开枝叶向另一侧窥望。
落叶松的阴影下有几个原住民。从人类学角度，你认出一些迹象，判断他们属于图苏蒂纳族，而且似乎是个相当与世隔绝的群体。他们穿着皮衬衫、绑腿和林地风格的莫卡辛鞋，显然很少接触外界。你看见几支十九世纪的步枪，其中一些还是单发式。查理提到过被放逐者——这会不会就是她说的那群人？

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 559
text: You follow the trail for almost a mile and finally hear a mutter of voices. Crawling up to a mass of bearberry bushes, you part them enough to see the other side.

There, in the shadow of the larches, you observe several Native people. Anthropologically, you recognize indicators of the Tsuut’ina, apparently a very isolated group. Their skin shirts, leggings, and woodland-style moccasins indicate minimal contact with the outside. You see several 19th- century rifles—some only single-shot weapons—among them. Charlie said something about outcasts—could this be the group she mentioned?
